summary: hdr_list count wraps after 65535 headers (integer overflow)
description: In tinyhdr before 1.4.1, hdr_list_add() increments the unsigned short `count` field without a bound. With 65536 or more headers the count wraps to zero and callers that size buffers from `count` can under-allocate. Fixed in 1.4.1 by capping headers at HDR_MAX_HEADERS.
